verdict.rationale: macOS ships Spotlight as a keyboard-driven launcher (macos-docs-15) and Shortcuts for automation, but multiple hands-on reports say native window management is poor and not keyboard-friendly, forcing users to rely on third-party tools like Moom for basic resize/move operations that should be keyboard-accessible (macos-comm-5, macos-comm-7, macos-comm-8, macos-comm-9). This contradicts a full 'operate entirely via keyboard' claim.
